description: Office of the Public Service Commission - 08th Amendment Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants Service
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Public Service Commission and specifically amends the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Accountants' Service. The content deals exclusively with public sector service administration, including salary scales, grade structures, recruitment methods, promotion criteria, and service conditions for government accountants. This falls under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) as it concerns public service recruitment, salary revisions, and administrative conditions for government employees.
